description: Call of Duty: Black Ops (2010) through OpenBLOPS, ported to Switch with Campaign, Zombies and Multiplayer. Needs your own PC copy, its zones converted on a PC.

notes: OpenBLOPS-NX.nro runs Campaign and Zombies, OpenBLOPS-NX-MP.nro Multiplayer; each can start the other.
Buttons go by position: A confirms and B goes back. Motion aiming is in Options, Controls, Gamepad.

inputs.label: Black Ops for PC (retail, with any DLC you want to play), its zones converted by the web installer

files.note: The zones, converted for the Switch

prepare.summary: The web installer converts every zone (DLC and localised zones too) in the browser and makes switch/OpenBLOPS-NX/ with the latest release's NROs, as a zip or straight into a folder.

generated.note: Your player name, a random one on first start

steps: On a PC, open https://hderick.github.io/OpenBLOPS-NX/ and give it main, zone and localization.txt from your Black Ops install.
Copy what it makes to the root of the SD card (it makes switch/OpenBLOPS-NX/), or drop it on PortZone's upload page.
Start OpenBLOPS-NX.nro with full memory: hold R while starting a game.
